extras.name: Omaha
extras.note: aerial-photograph ground (no open LiDAR over the built-up city: bare-earth LiDAR erases the streets); the street grid and the Missouri carry the fit; the 1868 E. Ruger sheet is the steepest (near-vertical) whole-city view in the pool (the 1905 Austen 'panoramic' oblique is the recorded dupe): drawn from a high vantage across the Missouri River - the river a foreground strip with steamboats and a railroad along the sheet's bottom, a thin hill-horizon band across the top - the city grid fills the sheet beyond the 2000 m town box, so its fit is likely to end a review item (the 236a NY-1811 / DC-ring precedent)

files.desc: Perspective map not drawn to scale. LC Panoramic maps (2nd ed.), 467 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Includes ill. and index to points of interest Vault AACR2: 100; 651/1; 710/1
